summary: Post-cutover Vantaca homeowner receipts post once: a unique index on homeowner_transactions (community_id, raw_row_jsonb->>'vantaca_ref') for rows from the receipts import, a unique index on journal_entries (community_id, source_reference) for 'VRCPT:' references, and two report types (vantaca_pay_payouts, deposit_register) in the vantaca_imports source registry. No existing row qualifies for either index; no row changes.

preflight.name: no receipts-import ledger rows exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE raw_row_jsonb->>'source' = 'vantaca_receipt'

preflight.name: no VRCPT journal references exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM journal_entries WHERE source_reference LIKE 'VRCPT:%'

expected_changes: Index uq_homeowner_txn_vantaca_receipt and index uq_journal_entries_vantaca_receipt_ref (partial, unique).
vantaca_imports_report_type_check also allows vantaca_pay_payouts and deposit_register.
No row changes in any table.

verify.name: both unique indexes exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname IN ('uq_homeowner_txn_vantaca_receipt','uq_journal_entries_vantaca_receipt_ref')
